body.p: Display IP is same for all the Meteor Lake and Arrow Lake SKUs.
Meteor Lake and Arrow Lake integrates Display14 into SOC Die which supports max four Type-C (DDI 1-4) and five combo ports (DDI A-E).
MTL/ARL die sets number of display capable Type C ports as 2 for MTL-M and 4 for MTL-P and 2 combo DDI ports supporting eDP, DP and HDMI; No MIPI support
